raw_response:
I am old now, 74 years. My back hurts in spring but cotton is what I know. 55 years I grow cotton on this land. My husband is gone, my sons work in the town factory, they come help when it is planting time and picking time. Two mu is not much but it is mine.

For the seed, I go to the shop in the town with my daughter-in-law. She reads the bags for me. I buy the new cotton seed, the one with the worm protection inside — everyone in the village buys this one now. The old kind, nobody plants it, the worms eat everything. I buy about one jin of seed, enough for my two mu. Maybe 40, 50 yuan.

For fertilizer — I do like always. Before planting, I spread one bag of the compound fertilizer, the one with three fifteens on it, across my two mu. One bag is 50 jin... no wait, 100 jin, 50 kilo. So about 25 kilo per mu at the base. My neighbor Old Zhang's wife, she puts the same. Then when the flowers come and bolls start, I put urea — half a bag across the two mu, maybe more if the leaves look yellow. Urea is the white one, I remember the bag.

Water — I have the well, my son helped fix the pump two years ago. I water three times. One time when I plant, because the ground must be wet. One time when flowers come. One time when bolls are filling. If no rain, maybe one more time. Cotton does not want too much water or the bolls rot.

Spraying — cotton has many enemies. Aphids come first in spring, then the bollworm, then the little red spiders, then white bugs. I spray with the backpack my son bought me. Six times, maybe seven. I mix what the shop man tells my daughter-in-law. This is the most tiring work for me now, my shoulders.

Ploughing — I cannot do this anymore. I pay the young man in the village with the small tractor, he does my two mu for 60 yuan. He uses the rotary blade, fast, done in one afternoon.

Yield — good year I pick 220, 230 kilo per mu. Last year was dry, only 190. I hope this year is normal. The price is not so good now but what else can I do with this land.
